The array $$$a$$$ in the input is constructed as follows:   $$$a_0$$$ is given in the input;  for every $$$i$$$ from $$$1$$$ to $$$n - 1$$$, the value of $$$a_i$$$ can be calculated as $$$a_i = (a_{i - 1} \cdot x + y) \bmod M$$$.
